worldcombat.skill.waterspout.summary: Raises a tide wall that surges outward from the user's feet: the front sweeps the ring around the user, and each foe it crosses takes a wave, is carried along, is soaked through and has its fire put out. Power falls with the user's remaining health, peaking at full HP, and rain makes it stronger. Undertow style reverses the push, dragging foes in.
worldcombat.skill.waterspout.use.0: Shove a whole ring away when surrounded
worldcombat.skill.waterspout.use.1: Put out a group's fire and soak them through
worldcombat.skill.waterspout.use.2: Wash a pursuer off your face
worldcombat.skill.waterspout.use.3: Deliver the biggest area water hit in the rain
worldcombat.skill.waterspout.description: The front sweeps the ring around the user: each foe inside takes about %1$s damage; the wall reaches about %2$s blocks and airborne and grounded targets are both swept. The target's Sp. Def, type and crit are settled on the hit.

The wall takes about %1$s s to travel from one edge to the other: the pushing style runs from the centre out and shoves a swept target about %2$s blocks away; the undertow style runs from the outer edge in and drags it about %2$s blocks closer. A swept target carries the soaked identity for about %3$s, moving 15% slower while it lasts.
worldcombat.skill.waterspout.undertow.on: Undertow style on: the front runs from the outer edge in, dragging foes toward the user and soaking longer, but the wave deals x0.82 and reaches less far, with wind-up +2 ticks and cooldown +6 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.waterspout.undertow.of: Pushing style: the front runs from the centre out, a stronger wave that shoves foes away, to wash a ring off your face.
worldcombat.skill.waterspout.timing: Cast on the space within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.waterspout.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown drops to %2$s s.
On: the tide reverses to drag foes toward the user and soaks longer, but the wave deals ×0.82, reaches less far and costs more wind-up and cooldown. Off (pushing): a stronger wave that shoves foes away, to wash a ring off your face.
Beyond this the companion waits outside the wave instead of closing in. Higher opens from farther away.

Pushing style: when foes crowd within 2.6 blocks the companion raises Water Spout to wash them off; off keeps the normal attack order. Undertow style always ranks by the number of movable foes inside the tide reach (knockback-resistant bosses are not counted).
worldcombat.skill.waterspout.description: On a hit, a target that is burning has its burn removed and its fire put out; either way every foe the front sweeps is left soaked.
